request: Pull the latest GDELT global events feed and load into a local Hyper extract for Tableau analysis. One row per event, geocoded by lat/lon with country, event-root code (CAMEO), Goldstein scale, and source URL. No country filter - keep events worldwide so we can map global activity by location.

sources.name: GDELT Global Events
sources.description: GDELT 1.0 daily events feed from data.gdeltproject.org. The skill scrapes the events index page for the most recent .CSV.zip, downloads + unzips it, and emits one row per event with full v1 schema (58 columns including Actor1/2 country/type, ActionGeo lat/lon and country, EventCode CAMEO, GoldsteinScale, NumMentions, AvgTone, SOURCEURL).

outputs.name: gdelt_global_events
outputs.description: GDELT 1.0 global events for the latest published day (one row per event). Use ActionGeo_Lat / ActionGeo_Long for map plots, ActionGeo_CountryCode for choropleths, EventRootCode (CAMEO root) for event-type breakdowns, GoldsteinScale (-10..+10) for conflict-cooperation tone.
